summary: Preserve caller loading geometry and avoid stale checkout replacement during asynchronous initialization
evidence: Actual Memory Casting cold cart load removed its SSR loading paragraph before awaiting initialization: footer moved up46.3958px, then the final cart shell insertion moved it below the viewport (CLS.1312). Core mountCheckout replaced caller DOM before its first awaited initialization.
rollback: Revert this public UI change and use its matching exact browser SDK; do not alter checkout prices, orders, provider bindings or recovery policy.
